checks.source: retire.js jsrepository-v4.json (GitHub/NVD advisories), reviewed 2026-11-02 against GHSA-v63q-hgqc-qvpg and NVD; CVE-2021-32821, CVE-2021-23432 (no patch); unmaintained since 1.6.0 (2016); OWASP Top 10 A06 (unsupported components)
checks.applicability: Applies to pages on which the library is detected: its window global (with its version field) or, for jQuery, Bootstrap, AngularJS, Lodash and Handlebars, a script URL whose path names the library and a version.
checks.expectation: Fails for every detected MooTools version: known advisories (CVE-2021-32821, CVE-2021-23432) have no patch, and the last release 1.6.0 is unmaintained, so no fixed line exists (OWASP A06). There is no conforming version; the negative is a look-alike: an application namespace that only shares part of the name is not `MooTools.version`. A page without the library: not applicable. A page that breaks the detection scripts (result missing or malformed) is not run for every library, never clean.
